reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, valid_from, valid_to - valid_from + 1 AS days_valid
FROM price_history
WHERE valid_to >= DATE '2024-12-01'
  AND valid_to <= DATE '2024-12-31'
alternatives: SELECT product_id, valid_from, date_diff('day', valid_from, valid_to) + 1 AS days_valid FROM price_history WHERE valid_to BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
SELECT product_id, valid_from, valid_to - valid_from + 1 AS days_valid FROM price_history WHERE year(valid_to) = 2024 AND month(valid_to) = 12

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, valid_from, valid_to - valid_from + 1 AS days_valid FROM price_history WHERE year(valid_to) = 2024 AND month(valid_to) = 12
other_way.tradeoff: Filtering on the year and month of valid_to is short, but a date range names both end days and works on any date column.

solver.query:
SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(valid_to AS DATE) - CAST(valid_from AS DATE) + 1 AS days_valid
FROM price_history
WHERE CAST(valid_to AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
